name: MU_Alma_Faculty_Demographics_Extract
description: Alma patron load (faculty), adapted for Colleague from the Ellucian-Alma guide (Banner). Extracts faculty with a section assignment in the target term (COURSE.SEC.FACULTY), maps them to the Alma user XML layout with a configurable Faculty user group, stages the XML in S3, zips it (Alma only ingests zipped XML), and delivers the dated zip to the Alma SFTP drop directory.

parameters.name: userGroupCode
parameters.label: Faculty User Group Code
parameters.description: Alma user_group code assigned to all faculty patrons. Must match a user group configured in Alma.

parameters.name: userGroupDesc
parameters.label: Faculty User Group Description
parameters.description: Alma user_group desc attribute for faculty patrons.

parameters.name: targetTerm
parameters.label: Target Term (optional)
parameters.description: Colleague term code (e.g. 2026FA). Leave blank to auto-resolve the current term: the earliest FA/SP/SU term whose end date has not passed. Drives the population selection and the expiry/purge date (term end + grace days).

parameters.name: expiryGraceDays
parameters.label: Expiry Grace Days
parameters.description: Days added to the target term end date to compute the Alma expiry_date/purge_date. Guide baseline is 30.

parameters.name: defaultEmail
parameters.label: Default Email Address
parameters.description: Fallback email_address when the person has no preferred or position-1 email on file (Alma requires an email element).

parameters.name: stagingBucket
parameters.label: Staging S3 Bucket
parameters.description: S3 bucket used to stage the XML so the ZipFile segment can package it. Alma only ingests zipped XML, and zipping in Data Connect requires S3 staging. Bucket name only, no directories.

parameters.name: stagingAccessKey
parameters.label: Staging S3 Access Key
parameters.description: Access key ID for the staging bucket.

parameters.name: stagingSecretKey
parameters.label: Staging S3 Secret Access Key
parameters.description: Secret access key for the staging bucket.

parameters.name: almaSftpHost
parameters.label: Alma SFTP Host
parameters.description: S/FTP host that the Alma SIS integration profile polls for user load files.

parameters.name: almaSftpUser
parameters.label: Alma SFTP Username
parameters.description: Username for the Alma SFTP endpoint.

parameters.name: almaSftpKey
parameters.label: Alma SFTP Private Key
parameters.description: OpenSSH private key for the Alma SFTP endpoint. Must include the BEGIN/END header and footer lines.

parameters.name: almaSftpPath
parameters.label: Alma SFTP Directory
parameters.description: Remote directory watched by the Alma SIS integration profile; the dated zip filename is appended automatically. Must match the input directory configured on the Alma integration profile.

config.selectQuery:
WITH

target_term AS (
    SELECT t.terms_id,
           t.term_end_date,
           TO_CHAR((t.term_end_date + ('{{context.expiryGraceDays}}')::integer * INTERVAL '1 day')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expiry_date
    FROM dbo.ods_terms t
    WHERE t.terms_id = COALESCE(NULLIF('{{context.targetTerm}}', ''), (
            SELECT t2.terms_id
            FROM dbo.ods_terms t2
            WHERE t2.term_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE
              AND (t2.terms_id LIKE '%FA' OR t2.terms_id LIKE '%SP' OR t2.terms_id LIKE '%SU')
            ORDER BY t2.term_start_date ASC
            LIMIT 1
        ))
),

teaching AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT csf.csf_faculty AS person_id
    FROM dbo.course_sec_faculty csf
    JOIN dbo.course_sections cs
        ON cs.course_sections_id = csf.csf_course_section
    WHERE cs.sec_term = (SELECT terms_id FROM target_term)
      AND csf.csf_faculty IS NOT NULL
),

address AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pai.id)
        pai.id            AS person_id,
        a.address_line_1,
        a.city,
        a.state,
        a.zip,
        a.country
    FROM dbo.ods_person_address_info pai
    JOIN dbo.ods_address a
        ON a.address_id = pai.person_addresses
    ORDER BY pai.id ASC, pai.pos ASC
),

email AS (
    SELECT pe.id                     AS person_id,
           pe.person_email_addresses AS email_address
    FROM people_email pe
    WHERE pe.pos = 1
)

SELECT
    t.person_id                                     AS primary_id,
    p.first_name                                    AS first_name,
    LEFT(p.middle_name, 1)                          AS middle_initial,
    p.last_name                                     AS last_name,
    NULL                                            AS user_title,
    TO_CHAR(p.birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')             AS birth_date,
    '{{context.userGroupCode}}'                 AS user_group_code,
    '{{context.userGroupDesc}}'                 AS user_group_desc,
    (SELECT expiry_date FROM target_term)           AS expiry_date,
    t.person_id                                     AS external_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.preferred_email_address), ''),
             NULLIF(TRIM(e.email_address), ''),
             '{{context.defaultEmail}}')        AS email_address,
    addr.address_line_1                             AS address_line_1,
    addr.city                                       AS city,
    addr.state                                      AS state,
    addr.zip                                        AS zip,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(addr.country), ''), 'USA') AS country
FROM teaching t
JOIN dbo.ods_person p
    ON p.id = t.person_id
LEFT JOIN address addr
    ON addr.person_id = t.person_id
LEFT JOIN email e
    ON e.person_id = t.person_id
ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name, t.person_id
